description.en: Learn essential digital skills to run your business more effectively using your smartphone. From organizing apps to using WhatsApp Business and Google Sheets.
description.sw: Jifunze ujuzi muhimu wa kidijitali kuendesha biashara yako kwa ufanisi zaidi kwa kutumia simu yako ya mkononi.
description.am: ስማርትፎንዎን በመጠቀም ንግድዎን ይበልጥ ውጤታማ በሆነ መንገድ ለማካሄድ አስፈላጊ የዲጂታል ክህሎቶችን ይማሩ።

description.en: Set up and manage mobile money for your business. Learn MTN Mobile Money and Airtel Money for payments, savings, and transfers.
description.sw: Weka na simamia pesa za simu kwa biashara yako. Jifunze MTN Mobile Money na Airtel Money kwa malipo, akiba, na uhamisho.
description.am: ለንግድዎ ሞባይል ገንዘብ ያዘጋጁ እና ያስተዳድሩ። ለክፍያዎች፣ ቁጠባ እና ዝውውር MTN Mobile Money እና Airtel Money ይማሩ።

description.en: Master free Google tools to grow your business. Learn Google Sheets for tracking, Google Docs for documents, and Google Drive for storage.
description.sw: Jifunze zana za bure za Google kukuza biashara yako. Jifunze Google Sheets, Google Docs, na Google Drive.
description.am: ንግድዎን ለማሳደግ ነፃ የGoogle መሳሪያዎችን ይማሩ። Google Sheets፣ Google Docs እና Google Drive ይማሩ።
